## Today's Question

How do we compare many models without losing the question?

## Many Models

Repeated models are useful when groups differ.

They are dangerous when automation hides failures.

## Workflow

- Split or group data.
- Fit one model per group.
- Extract comparable summaries.
- Inspect failures and diagnostics.

## AI Check

Model ranking without diagnostics is incomplete.
